collection.title: Renault Clio Hatchback 2019 to 2025 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Renault Clio 2019 - 2025 model which requires a 28" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 12" for the passengers side. This model uses the Renault Specific arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Clio Hatchback, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
